trailhead.label: Passo San Pellegrino (Moena), the APT’s start

cautions: Open alpine pasture at about 1,900–1,970 m with cattle in summer: keep your distance.
Gravel track shared with the refuge’s vehicles and, in some years, a horse-drawn carriage.
No shade on the open basin, strong sun and wind.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
